n: MIXER AMPLIFIER, The A-2030 is a high cost-performance mixer poweramplifier suited
d: The A-2030 is a high cost-performance mixer poweramplifier suited for broadcasting paging or backgroundmusic in schools, offices, shops, factories, mosques,churches and large rooms.

specs.label: Input
specs.value: MIC 1 - 3: -60 dB, 600 Ω, balanced, phone jack; AUX 1,2: -20 dB, 10 kΩ, unbalanced, RCA pin jack

specs.label: Output
specs.value: Speaker out: Balanced (floating); High impedance: 330 Ω (100 V), 170 Ω (70 V); Low impedance: 4 Ω (11 V); Rec out: 0 dB, 600 Ω, unbalanced, RCA pin jack

specs.label: Tone Control
specs.value: Bass: ±10 dB at 100 Hz; Treble: ±10 dB at 10 kHz

specs.label: Muting
specs.value: MIC 1: Mutes other input signals by 0 - 30 dB attenuation

specs.label: Finish
specs.value: Panel: ABS resin, black; Case: Steel plate, black
